invariant_bindings.invariant_text: Buffer length MUST never exceed `maxlen`; oldest entries are evicted FIFO once the ring is full (deque-with-maxlen semantics).
`get_all()` MUST return entries in newest-first order (reverse of insertion).
`get_by_id(id)` MUST return the stored dict iff an entry with matching `id` is still in the buffer; else None (no exceptions).
